rule: Each digest is sha256 over bytes produced by the production function named in `source`. Where an authority owns its own canonical serializer the digest is taken over that output directly; where a production function returns an object rather than bytes, `source` names both the subject producer and the repository canonical serializer used to render it. The subject is the literal value built in tests/characterization/repair-campaign-authority-freeze.test.ts. A moved digest means an authority changed; re-deriving the value to make the test pass is never the correct repair.
